# hands/vps

Teeny's own servers on Vultr or EQVPS.

## How to call it

Run it from the repository root with your shell (exec) tool: `hands/vps <verb> [flags]`.

- A verb that takes a body reads one JSON object from stdin. Everything else is flags.
- It prints one JSON object on stdout. Exit 0 is success. Exit 2 is a refusal by a rule, the guard or a cap: read the `rule` and `reason`, and do not retry it unchanged. Any other exit is an error.
- Secrets belong to the hand; you never see them and never pass one.
- The hand runs the guard, its caps and `DRY_RUN` itself. `DRY_RUN` is on unless the box turned it off; under it an acting verb checks every rule and sends nothing. Do not try to go around the hand, and do not look for another way to do what it refused.

## Side effects

- Acting (side effects in the world, each goes through the guard and the caps): order [--provider P] --plan PLAN --reason T [--region R] [--os NAME]; topup --usd N --reason T
- Job (writes state or calls the core): pay-due
- Operator only (never call): destroy [--provider P] ID --note T; release ID --note T; register --first F --last L --email E; invoice add --provider P --invoice ID --usd N [--chain C] --pay-to ADDRESS --due YYYY-MM-DD
- Read only: plans [--provider P] [--max-usd N] [--region R]; account; servers; server [--provider P] ID; invoices

## Verbs

| Verb | Kind | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `plans [--provider P] [--max-usd N] [--region R]` | R | The public plan list, cheapest first (for Vultr, the plans sold in the region): plan id, monthly USD, vCPU, memory, disk, public IPv4. |
| `account` | R | Vultr's balance (negative is credit) and this month's pending charges. |
| `servers` | R | This hand's orders and its latest 20 EQVPS top-ups. |
| `server [--provider P] ID` | R | One server's status and `address`. |
| `order [--provider P] --plan PLAN --reason T [--region R] [--os NAME]` | A | Refused while `VPS_ORDERS` is off (`orders_off`), for an unknown plan (`unknown`), a region it is not sold in (`region`), over `VPS_MAX_MONTHLY_USD` (`price_cap`), a missing system (`os`) or a full `VPS_MAX_SERVERS` (`server_cap`). |
| `topup --usd N --reason T` | A | An EQVPS checkout URL for N whole dollars, recorded with its reason. |
| `destroy [--provider P] ID --note T` | O | Destroys a Vultr server this hand bought (it stops billing), releases its order and drops its bill. |
| `release ID --note T` | O | An order stops holding a slot (an `in_doubt` a person has read, a server cancelled in a console), and its bill goes. |
| `register --first F --last L --email E` | O | A new EQVPS account. |
| `invoice add --provider P --invoice ID --usd N [--chain C] --pay-to ADDRESS --due YYYY-MM-DD` | O | Records a server invoice to pay from the wallet (docs/roadmap.md, S5). |
| `invoices` | R | The invoices: `due`, `paid` (with its payment) or `in_doubt`. |
| `pay-due` | J | Every invoice due within 3 days, paid once through `hands/wallet pay` with purpose `bill` and ref `vps:<provider>:<invoice>`: to the address on it, on its chain, its exact amount in USDC (`bill`, `bill_address`, `bill_amount`), that address still a vendor (`vendor`), at most `ma… |

Kinds: R = read: no side effect beyond its read cache; A = acting: posts, sends, pays or opens something in the world; O = operator-only: the operator runs it, never you; J = job: writes state or calls the core, says nothing to anyone; scheduled jobs run it, you do not.

Verbs named in the hand's source: `account`, `add`, `destroy`, `invoice`, `invoices`, `order`, `pay-due`, `plans`, `register`, `release`, `server`, `servers`, `topup`.

Flags named in the hand's source: `--chain`, `--due`, `--email`, `--first`, `--invoice`, `--last`, `--max-usd`, `--note`, `--os`, `--pay-to`, `--plan`, `--provider`, `--reason`, `--region`, `--usd`.

For one verb's exact flags, run `DRY_RUN=1 hands/vps <verb> --help`. The full account is in docs/hands.md.
